purpose: Comparable art-direction concepts; not Unity screenshots or production assets.

prompts.name: fox-host-character-v1
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original video game character design sheet, landscape, beautiful professional art direction presentation.
Primary request: Design a fox spirit host for an intimate supernatural dice game in a roadside house. Clearly an ANIMAL fox given intelligence, upright seated bearing and slightly dexterous forepaws, never a human with fox ears. Adult, elegant, sly, courteous, quietly uncanny. Long narrow vulpine muzzle, very large pointed ears, dark charcoal forepaws, rust red coat, cream throat ruff, pale gold iris and dark slit pupil, one large flowing tail with cream tip. Lean fox body proportions, not broad human shoulders or human hands. A simple weathered deep green sleeveless waistcoat, open neck, no hat, no jewelry or weapons. Original fictional folklore, no specific traditional religious symbols.
Composition: warm parchment design board with three clearly separated studies of THE SAME CHARACTER. Large left two-thirds: three-quarter full-body portrait perched upright on a plain wooden chair at the edge of a small table, paw delicately touching a wooden die, SINGLE long tail curls beside chair. Top right: large close-up of face with polite, knowing half-smile, teeth not bared. Bottom right: small uncanny moment study, same fox turns serious, faint amber light under the ruff and a few fading ember-like particles from tail tip; its shadow points its ears in a different direction. The actual animal remains opaque and tangible. Clean readable silhouette, appealing rather than cute baby proportions.
Style: painterly illustrated character suitable for 2D skeletal animation in a hybrid 3D tabletop game, rich brushwork and restrained graphic shapes. Maintain the exact same face and waistcoat in all studies. Visible individual tufts, no photorealism, no anime, no chibi, no horror gore, no blue transparent ghost, no multiple tails.
Lighting: warm amber lamplight and subtle cool rain-blue edge light. Text only small title at top: "THE FOX HOST". Do not add annotations, logos or watermarks. This is a concept sheet, not a rendered game screenshot.

prompts.name: b-hybrid-gameplay-v1
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-quality landscape 16:9 gameplay concept composition for a supernatural dice game. This is a single FULL GAME SCREEN, not a collage or character sheet.
Input image: character identity reference ONLY. Preserve this fox's face, narrow muzzle, tall ears, rust fur, cream ruff, dark forepaws, green waistcoat and single tail. Do not copy the reference sheet layout.
Primary request: show the HYBRID art direction: tactile stylized THREE-DIMENSIONAL dice and wooden gaming table in the foreground, a visibly PAINTED illustrated fox host and layered illustrated room behind them. A unified coherent aesthetic with real 3D contact shadows on foreground objects and painterly line/brushwork on the host. Not photorealism.
Camera and composition: player's seated first-person viewpoint across a broad wooden table, camera tilted down enough to read all five dice. Fox's upper body centered in the upper third; face clearly visible and expressive. Its paws rest at the back edge of the table, one paw by a teacup. Quiet sly welcoming expression. Left background rain-blue window, right background amber oil lamp and dark shelves. Warm rustic roadside house, faded green wood, blue rain, amber glow. A subtle uncanny fox shadow falls toward the wrong side. The dice tray dominates the middle-lower half with EXACTLY FIVE dice in five evenly spaced ordered slots. No extra dice elsewhere. The huge tail curls behind the host at right, a few pale gold motes off the tip, no flames covering gameplay.
UI layout: sharp clean readable cream lettering in thin dark translucent panels, no ornate heavy frames. Small top-left concept label "B / HYBRID". Across top center "THE LAST LANTERN"; top-right "STAGE 2 / 25". Under title, small counters "HANDS 3" and "REROLLS 2". At left of tray a compact panel "TARGET 225". Dice show faces 2, 2, 2, 5, 5, from left to right. Under tray: "FULL HOUSE" and "36 x 6 = 216". Then two distinct buttons "REROLL SELECTED" and "PLAY HAND". The bottom edge has a compact inventory strip of 24 small charm tiles arranged in two neat rows of twelve, readable silhouettes, with label "CHARMS". Charms are small polished wood and ceramic tokens with simple original geometric symbols. Do not add explanatory paragraphs or card text. UI is practical and restrained, legible above the textured world, unobstructed controls.
Mood: intimate, warm, sly and gently uncanny, strong painterly art direction, detailed yet clean gameplay hierarchy. This must visibly combine dimensional 3D tabletop objects with a 2D illustrated host. Preserve fox identity. No logos, no watermarks, no human player body, no weapons, no skulls, no multiple tails.
